title: Make the lost-requirements check read only the reference's canonical files, spare archived changes, report beside a change's own errors, and name an unreadable path
description: Make the lost-requirements check read only the reference's canonical files, spare archived changes, report beside a change's own errors, and name an unreadable path
acceptance_criteria: (1) REQ-change-175: the files read at the reference come only from what was canonical there; a branch that registers a spec beside, or moves specs_dir onto, a requirements.md that was already there and rewrites it is not refused for its old ids; a requirement moved into a newly canonical file is found there. (2) REQ-change-176: change audit reports the lost requirements for each active change whether or not its approval, delta files and delta bodies validate, beside its own error. (3) REQ-change-177: when a requirement would be reported lost and a requirements directory or file in the working tree could not be read, the check says it cannot tell, naming each path and the error and the way out; nothing changes when nothing is lost. (4) REQ-cmd-change-045: change ship-status lists the lost-requirements blocker only for a change that can still be checked, finalized or shipped, not for an archived or retired one.

answers.constraints: No new refusal and no change to REQ-change-169's or REQ-cmd-change-042's wording: four ADDED requirements. #1112 and #1113 only remove false refusals; #1116 adds lines only where the audit already fails for that change; #1117 gives the existing 'cannot tell' form in place of a wrong loss report, at the same points, only when a loss would otherwise be reported. Stacked on #1108 (ed258f58).
